title: Lost card on the way to work

turns.message: I can't find my card anywhere.
turns.reply:
I am sorry to hear that you cannot find your card. If you cannot locate your Horizon card, you can temporarily freeze it through the Horizon App by following these steps:

Log into your account in the Horizon App.

On the card overview screen, tap "View & Manage Card."

Select "Freeze Card."

For a card that is lost or stolen, first freeze it and then request a replacement. Log into the Horizon App, open the card dashboard, and choose "View & Manage Card." Tap "Freeze Card" followed by "Order Replacement." Horizon will issue a new card and permanently deactivate the old one. You may also wish to file a police report. Please note that the new card will arrive with a different card number, so be sure to update any recurring payments or subscriptions with the new details. For additional assistance, select "Contact Us" from the app menu. If you prefer, you can also access these features directly using the Manage Card button below.

turns.message: Will it cost me anything to get a new one?
turns.reply: Horizon Bank does not charge any fees for replacing a lost or damaged Horizon card, so getting a replacement will not cost you anything.

turns.message: How long will the new card take to arrive?
turns.reply: Your replacement Horizon card should arrive within 6-7 business days from the date you applied.

turns.message: My new card just came in the mail. How do I start using it?
turns.reply:
Access your Horizon App account by logging in with your credentials.

Navigate to the section labeled 'Account Management' and select the option related to your physical card.

Choose the 'Activate Your Card' feature, which will prompt you to select an activation method.

For NFC activation, click 'Proceed' and hold your card against the back of your device. Alternatively, opt for code activation by selecting 'Enter Code Manually' and input the unique code provided in your welcome materials.

Please note that all newly issued, replaced, or renewed Horizon cards must be activated before they can be used for transactions.

If you'd rather skip these steps, you can also manage your card directly using the Manage Card button below.

turns.message: And how do I set a PIN for it?
turns.reply: You can also manage your security settings and update your PIN directly using the Security Settings button below.

turns.message: Can I add it to Apple Pay too?
turns.reply: Yes, you can add your new Horizon card to Apple Pay. Your digital card allows you to execute virtually all card-related transactions within Singapore through platforms such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, and the FairPrice app. Once set up, you can also use Apple Pay for in-store purchases alongside online and mobile application payments.

You can use the live-chat or voice-call feature within the Horizon App, or call our support centre at +65 313-HORIZON (+65 3138 7878).
Transaction Security Best Practices: As related information regarding electronic payment safeguards, please remember to promptly report any suspicious activity, utilize the self-service kill switch feature in the Horizon App to block further access if needed, and carefully review risk warning messages before proceeding with transactions.

turns.message: How do I dispute it?
turns.reply: To initiate a dispute for an unauthorized charge on your Horizon card, you can contact us through the Horizon App by starting a live-chat or requesting a voice call. Alternatively, you can call our support centre at +65 313-HORIZ (+65 3138 7878).

turns.message: Should I freeze my card in the meantime?
turns.reply: Yes, if you suspect fraudulent or suspicious activity, you should immediately freeze your Horizon card. You can lock your card through the Horizon App by selecting "View and Manage card" from the home screen and then choosing "Lock card". For any additional inquiries, you can reach out via the voice call or live-chat feature in the Horizon App, or call our hotline at +65 313-HORIZON (+65 3138 7878).

Please note that the new card will arrive with a different card number, so be sure to update any recurring payments or subscriptions with the new details. If you prefer, you can also fill in and submit the Replace Card form below.

turns.message: When will my transfer move from pending to confirmed?
turns.reply:
Domestic Transfer Processing Time: Horizon Bank sends domestic transfers instantly and you receive an immediate confirmation. However, the recipient's bank may require additional time to process and settle the transaction.
Security Holding Period: For your protection, Horizon Bank has implemented a robust security protocol that temporarily holds certain transactions for 24 hours. This precautionary measure is designed to detect and prevent potential phishing scams that could lead to unauthorized account access. Unless you decide to cancel the transaction, it will be automatically processed after the holding period, ensuring the security of your funds with Horizon Bank.

Choose the field you wish to modify, which is your phone number.

Enter the one-time password (OTP) sent to you.

Provide your Horizon Key for additional verification before the update is applied.

After you submit, the change will be processed within 12 hours for phone numbers and email addresses.
